notes: Here's what you'll be able to do by the end. One, pick the right tasks: know which work AI makes faster and better, and which work it gets wrong. Two, spot the risks: leaking company information, invented facts, copyright, and labeling what you publish are the four most common traps. Three, follow our rules: the company has six rules for using AI. We'll go through each one and show you what it rests on.
